race.comment: DETRIMENTAL (1) raced near the lead and stuck on well but just missed the placings last time out over 1350m at Doomben. Fitter for three runs back from a spell and has placed twice at the mile. Ready to find his best. NAUGHTY NURSE (9) gave away a big start on straightening but lengthened nicely to be beaten under a length recently over 1600m at the Sunshine Coast. Major player down in the weights. DIVIL A BIT (3) continued his fine recent form with a narrow win over this distance at Ipswich last Friday. Has raced here twice for two minor placings. No reason he cannot play a key role again. ROMANTIC BUBBLE (4) races beyond a sprint journey for the first time. On-pacer who lacked the turn of foot when asked at Warwick over 1350m last time. The longer trip may have come at the right time. TARAVIA (5) resumes. Went to the paddock in excellent form but probably needs this run. One for the exotics.
